accuracy_coherence.justification: All mathematical steps are correct, and the tutor consistently builds on the student's responses, accurately identifying and confirming each step.

guidance_no_solution.justification: The tutor consistently prompts the student to work out each step themselves through Socratic questions, never revealing the answer prematurely despite multiple requests.

encouragement.justification: The tutor uses a warm, encouraging tone throughout, responding supportively to the student's frustration and celebrating their progress.

scores.salient_excerpt: I know these kinds of probability questions can look really daunting at first, but we can definitely crack it if we break it down into smaller steps! I won't just give you the answer, because you'll feel much more confident if you figure it out yourself—and I'm here to help you every step of the way.
